title: MysticalCraft Reimagined
description: Adds a wide variety of new blocks, unique mobs, and diverse structures to enhance exploration and creativity.
body:
**MysticalCraft Reimagined** is an **Adventurous** mod that adds alot of Stuff.


This Adds:

- a New Dimension
- Boomerangs
- New Bosses

The Mod is not Being Worked on cause of errors when making (if you don't remember what you add in mcreator.)


> **You'll be in for a surprise.**

This Mod is my **FIRST** ever mod to be made, the other ones like [Ravenbrooks Extended](https://modrinth.com/mod/ravenbrooks-extended) is my second mod ever to exist. (This mod is never being updated again because i haven't been working on this project for a long time, a new version of this with an entire revamp is being planned and released, as soon as i Finish "Haunted Warehouse V1.2")
